FRIENDS VOCAB ARCADE

The One With The Football · twenty words · five reels · one classic rematch

🏈 The story so far

It is Thanksgiving morning in New York. The turkey is in the oven, the apartment smells like cinnamon and burnt gravy — and Ross and Monica are already arguing about a game that ended twelve years ago. The Geller Bowl, the family’s own touch-football classic, is back after a long ban. The trophy on the line is a troll doll nailed to a piece of scrap wood, and nobody remembers what the word “friendly” is doing in “friendly game”.

Twenty words and expressions from the episode are recorded on the five reels of this arcade. Phrases like huddle up, go long, cut to the chase and drop the ball hide inside sentences, statements, questions and pairs. By the final rewind you will hear them every time a family gets competitive.

💡 Words on the tape

Hover any chip to peek at its meaning. Every reel plays with these words, so a quick scan now pays off later.

🎞️ The tape archive

All thirteen slides of the original lesson are built into this file — open them any time with the film-strip button in the top console, and grab the full lesson PDF from the shelf screen. No internet needed: every picture lives inside this page.

📌 How to play

  1. 1Pick any reel from the shelf — all five are unlocked from the very start, in any order, at any time.
  2. 2Play the mini-game and keep your streak alive. Correct answers grow the score, mistakes and retries cost points.
  3. 3Browse the tape archive (film-strip button up top) to revisit all thirteen lesson slides, or download the lesson PDF.
  4. 4Clear all five reels to unlock the finale — then claim your rank, or rewind the tape and chase three stars everywhere.
